lines: Telo Ride now has a Settings page: how it looks, sounds and moves on this device.
It opens from Profile's Ride settings row, with Profile still current in the header.
Five sections, each a landmark with its heading, and a nav that goes to each one.
Turn Keep the screen awake off, and it applies at once, with no Save. It stays on this device, and a class ride lets the screen sleep.
Settings, from a phone to the full screen.
Reset puts every setting back. And where the browser keeps nothing, Settings says so, and every control still works.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
